description: Resolve a streaming/rental/purchase service's name (e.g. 'Netflix', 'Disney Plus') to its TMDB numeric provider id. Feed the id into discover_movies/discover_tv's with_watch_providers, with the same watch_region, to find top titles on that service. TMDB has no name-based lookup for this, only numeric ids, and there are hundreds of providers (296 in the US), so don't guess an id. A provider's id, and whether it's offered at all, can differ by country (checked live: Amazon Prime Video is 9 in the US, Germany and Japan but 119 in France, India and Brazil), so search in the country you'll filter in.

media_type.description: Whether to search movie or TV providers. A service can be offered for one media type but not the other (its id stays the same either way; a movie-only or TV-only service just returns nothing from the wrong media_type).

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination (TMDB returns up to 20 results per page, max 500).

query.description: Service name (or part of it) to look up, e.g. 'Netflix'.

watch_region.description: The user's country (pass it when known), whose provider list to search; discover_* defaults its watch_region to the same country. A service not offered there comes back as no match, so retry with another country before concluding it doesn't exist.

name: search_watch_providers
title: Search streaming/rental providers
